params.body:
After #153 the lines between relations were almost invisible until a dot was pointed at, so the picture no longer showed who works with whom. This follows the approach of the Gentells observatory 3D view: light lines everywhere, the focused node's own lines strong in its colour.

- At rest: every shared-project line is drawn in the colour of the busier of its two relations, at 13% (5% when a small relation is involved). Red lines therefore show what hangs together with relations only Geert carries.
- Pointing at a relation: its own lines at 75% in its colour and thicker by shared projects; other lines fade to almost nothing, other dots dim, neighbours get their names.
- Pointing at a line: it lights up and a tooltip names both relations and the number of shared projects.
- 3D: same colours; faint lines become pale grey there, since 3D draws lines with one opacity.
- The note under the graph says what pointing does.

Checked in the browser on the 733-relation demo copy: rest state, hover on Gemeente Zulte, the 3D switch (no console errors). 339 PHP tests and the network-model JS tests pass, pint clean.
